required_record: Cycle brief with current partner contacts; roles; decision owner; milestones; source vintage; delivery format; planned outputs
blocking_condition: Missing decision owner; unconfirmed source vintage; inferred rather than confirmed milestones; undefined deliverables
exit_condition: Partner confirms scope; roles; milestones; source vintage; delivery format; and decision owner
retained_evidence: Cycle brief and confirmed scope record

required_record: Dated intake manifest; delivered source files; codebook or model notes; prior methodology; change log; table shells; uncertainty or suppression rules
blocking_condition: Missing or unreadable files; undocumented source; unversioned package; absent methodology needed to reproduce the product
exit_condition: Complete versioned package is preserved and every required input is either present or explicitly logged as missing
retained_evidence: Intake manifest and preserved source package

required_record: Current-versus-prior comparison of population definition; source vintage; geography; denominators; weighting or model rules; exclusions; uncertainty rules; and table structure
blocking_condition: Any material method change is unexplained; comparability is assumed rather than demonstrated; source vintage is ambiguous
exit_condition: Every material change is documented with its expected effect on comparability and publication language

required_record: Reproduced headline totals; component reconciliations; prior-publication comparison; QA results; opened discrepancy records
blocking_condition: Headline totals cannot be reproduced; components do not reconcile; material break lacks a discrepancy record
exit_condition: Required totals reproduce or every material exception has an owned discrepancy record with evidence needs

entry_condition: QA has identified questions or confirmed no material discrepancies
required_record: Question/discrepancy log with owner role; materiality; evidence requested; response; decision; disclosure need; and status
blocking_condition: Material discrepancy remains unresolved; partner response is missing for a decision that depends on it; evidence contradicts proposed interpretation
exit_condition: Material issues are resolved or explicitly disclosed and any remaining nonmaterial items are documented for handoff

entry_condition: Analysis and material discrepancy review are complete
required_record: Final tables; methodology/source notes; required disclosures; citation check; publication handoff; explicit approval or hold record
blocking_condition: Missing sign-off; stale source or citation; unresolved material issue; release disclosure not carried into public copy
exit_condition: Designated reviewer records approval or an explicit hold and the public-release decision matches the evidence

required_record: Final source package; reviewed tables; methodology version; discrepancy log; approval record; publication URL or hold note; next-cycle open questions
blocking_condition: Missing provenance; missing approval/hold record; final package cannot reproduce the published or held decision
exit_condition: Cycle package is archived with enough evidence for a new analyst to reconstruct decisions without relying on oral memory
retained_evidence: Archive manifest and next-cycle handoff note
